summary_text: Q1 2026 reported ~late April: net income $134.2M, basic EPS $1.31, revenue $830.7M, Adj EBITDA $325.6M. Aerospace Products revenue and EBITDA more than doubled YoY; aerospace revenue +104% to $743.8M. Catalysts: continued engine program uptake, FTAI Power converting retired CFM56 engines to gas turbines for AI data centers, JV with Jereh Group on Mod-1 CFM56 aeroderivative production, upsized credit/warehouse facilities, third straight dividend increase to $0.45. Long-term narrative: $5.7B revenue / $1.6B earnings by 2029 implying 31.7% yearly revenue growth. Risk: execution and concentration around legacy engine families. Q1 already reported — next earnings ~early August 2026.
